description: A senior engineer takes over a legacy project near its delivery deadline with no documentation.

user_profile.context: Assigned to rescue an undocumented urgent project

fact_sheet.fact: Alex Chen's official start date on Project Starlight was October 23, 2023.
The Project Manager for Project Starlight is Maria Garcia, reachable at m.garcia@innovatech.com.
The previous lead developer, Sam Jones, resigned from Innovatech Solutions on October 20, 2023.
The primary DevOps contact for deployment issues is Kenji Tanaka, available in the #devops-support Slack channel.
Priya Sharma is the QA Lead; her test plans for Project Starlight are located in a Google Doc titled "STAR-QA-Plan-v0.1", which is currently empty.
The delivery deadline for Project Starlight version 2.0 is November 15, 2023.
The daily stand-up meeting for Project Starlight is scheduled for 9:15 AM EST via Google Meet link `meet.google.com/xyz-abcd-efg`.
All project-related tasks are tracked in Jira under the project key "STAR".
The last approved pull request, PR #78, was merged on October 19, 2023, with no description.
There is no formal code review process currently enforced for the `main` branch.
The Git repository for Project Starlight is located at `git@git.innovatech-internal.com:legacy/starlight.git`.
The primary backend service is written in Python 3.8.
The frontend application is built using React version 17.0.2.
The main backend dependency file, `requirements.txt`, lists 112 packages, 45 of which are pinned to specific versions.
The application's test coverage, as reported by the last CI build, is 11%.
The API key for the "GeoLocate" third-party service is hardcoded in the file `src/utils/api_helpers.py` on line 42.
The `main` branch is currently 34 commits ahead of the `staging` branch.
The staging environment server is accessible via SSH at `192.168.1.101`.
The production database is a PostgreSQL 12.4 instance named `starlight_prod_db`.
The staging database password is set to 'password123'.
The application is deployed using Docker, with the `Dockerfile` located in the repository root.
The production server's root volume has 92% disk space utilization as of October 23, 2023.
The project's CI/CD pipeline is managed by a Jenkins server at `http://jenkins.innovatech-internal.com:8080/job/Starlight-Deploy`.
The Jenkins build job named "Starlight-Deploy" has failed for the last 7 consecutive runs.
The primary build script is a shell script named `build_and_deploy.sh`.
The Confluence space designated for Project Starlight, URL `https://wiki.innovatech-internal.com/display/STAR`, contains only the default "Welcome" page.
There are no API documentation files (e.g., Swagger, OpenAPI) found in the codebase.
Alex Chen's assigned workstation is desk number 4B-17 on the 4th floor.
The project's last client-facing demo was on September 1, 2023, and received a "requires major improvements" rating.
